services.name: Mercy Fitzgerald Hospital (Trinity Health)
services.notes: Closest full-service hospital and ER since the 2025 Crozer closures. Community teaching hospital.

services.name: Lankenau Medical Center (Main Line Health)
services.notes: Highly rated regional medical center; cardiology and surgery strengths.

services.name: Penn Presbyterian Medical Center
services.notes: Level 1 trauma center; Penn Medicine network. Direct El ride from 69th Street.

services.name: CVS Pharmacy — 69th Street area
services.notes: Chain pharmacy near the transit hub; multiple CVS locations across the township.

services.name: H Mart Upper Darby
services.notes: Large Asian supermarket at the transit hub; standout produce and seafood.

services.name: 69th Street halal markets
services.notes: Multiple halal butchers and Middle Eastern/South Asian groceries along the corridor.

services.name: 69th Street Transportation Center
services.notes: Market-Frankford El terminus + trolleys 101/102 + Norristown High Speed Line + bus routes. Seniors 65+ ride free with SEPTA Senior Key Card.

services.name: WSFS Bank — Upper Darby area branches
services.notes: Largest Delaware County-based bank; multiple branches near the township.

services.name: PNC Bank — 69th Street
services.notes: National bank branch with ATMs near the hub.

services.name: Metropolitan Veterinary Associates (24/7 ER)
services.notes: Regional 24/7 veterinary emergency and specialty hospital. Routine care available from several local practices within 2-3 mi.

services.name: Naylor's Run Park
services.notes: Township's main linear park — trails and open space along Naylor's Run creek.

services.name: 69th Street international dining corridor
services.notes: West African, Caribbean, South Asian, Middle Eastern, and East Asian restaurants — one of the best cheap-eats strips in the Philadelphia metro.

services.name: Philadelphia International Airport (PHL)
services.notes: About 20-25 min by car; also reachable by SEPTA with a transfer.
